platforms.name: Shopify
platforms.short: Install from the Shopify App Store.

meta.title: InkyBay for Shopify | Product customizer app
meta.description: Add a live product design editor to your Shopify store. Install InkyBay from the Shopify App Store, set up products and get print-ready orders.

platforms.lead: Let shoppers personalize text, images and artwork on any product with a live preview. Install from the Shopify App Store and go live without code.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Add InkyBay from the Shopify App Store in a couple of clicks.

steps.title: Embed
steps.text: Turn on the app embed in your theme editor. No code needed.

steps.title: Product setup
steps.text: Pick products, draw print areas and choose what shoppers can customize.

steps.title: Start selling
steps.text: Shoppers design their products and you get print-ready orders.

requirements.title: A Shopify store
requirements.text: InkyBay installs from the Shopify App Store on your store.

requirements.title: A theme with app embeds
requirements.text: Turn the editor on from the theme editor, no code changes.

requirements.title: Billing through Shopify
requirements.text: Plans are billed on your Shopify invoice, with a 21-day free trial.

faqs.q: How do I install InkyBay on Shopify?
faqs.a: Open the InkyBay listing on the Shopify App Store, press Install and approve the app. Then turn on the app embed in your theme editor.

faqs.q: Does it work with my theme?
faqs.a: InkyBay adds its editor through a theme app embed, so it works with your current theme without code changes.
Plans are billed through Shopify in USD with your Shopify invoice, and every plan starts with a 21-day free trial.

platforms.short: Add InkyBay to your BigCommerce store.

meta.title: InkyBay for BigCommerce | Product customizer app
meta.description: Add a live product design editor to your BigCommerce store. Shoppers personalize products with a live preview and you get print-ready orders.

platforms.lead: Let shoppers personalize text, images and artwork on any product with a live preview. Add InkyBay to your BigCommerce store and go live without code.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Add InkyBay to your store from the BigCommerce app marketplace.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: Turn the editor on for your storefront. No code needed.

steps.title: Product setup
steps.text: Pick products, draw print areas and choose what shoppers can customize.

steps.title: Start selling
steps.text: Shoppers design their products and you get print-ready orders.

requirements.title: A BigCommerce store
requirements.text: InkyBay installs as an app on your BigCommerce store.

requirements.title: Store owner access
requirements.text: You need permission to install apps on the store.

requirements.title: No coding
requirements.text: Setup happens in the InkyBay dashboard, not in your theme files.

faqs.q: How do I install InkyBay on BigCommerce?
faqs.a: Open the InkyBay listing for BigCommerce, press Install and approve the app, then turn the editor on for your storefront.

faqs.q: Are the features the same as on Shopify?
faqs.a: The design editor, product setup and print-ready files are the same. Ask our team about a specific feature before you start.
Pricing for BigCommerce is shown on the app listing. Talk to our team if you have questions about plans.
